dct_description_sm: This project is designed to study the benthic and pelagic food web based on stable carbon and nitrogen isotopic ratios as part of the Beaufort Regional Environmental Assessment (BREA) marine fishes program. Changes in food web positions and relationships between key fish and invertebrate species will also be investigated across depth gradients and across distinct oceanographic habitats (influence of water originating from the Pacific Ocean, Atlantic Ocean, and Mackenzie River).
dct_title_s: Beaufort Regional Environmental Assessment (BREA) Marine Fishes Project - Isotope data; Foodweb study on the Canadian Beaufort Sea 2013
